title: How do I fix dropped stitches?
imageAlt: Diagram showing how to fix a dropped stitch
metaTitle: How to Fix Dropped Stitches on a Knitting Machine | Ask ’n Answer
metaDescription: Dropped a stitch on your knitting machine? Here’s how to spot it, lift it back up the ladder, and secure it so your work stays intact.

mainEntity.name: How do I fix dropped stitches?

acceptedAnswer.text: To fix a dropped stitch on a knitting machine, stop knitting as soon as you notice it. Use a latch tool to pick up the loop and pull it through each ladder rung until you reach the active row. Place the repaired stitch back on the correct needle and continue knitting. If the stitch has dropped multiple rows, work slowly and keep ladder bars straight so the tension stays even. For large drops or textured fabrics, it may help to remove the fabric and rehang it before repairing.

body:
Dropped stitches happen to everyone. The key is to catch them early and walk the stitch back up to the current row.

  1. Stop as soon as you notice the drop
  2. Find the dropped stitch and pick up with a transfer tool
  3. Use the latch tool (hook facing you) to relatch the stitch back up
  4. Put the stitch back on the needle without twisting it
